Checkout now rejects an expired coupon with a 400 and "coupon has expired". `node --test` passes all 83 tests, including the three in `src/billing/coupon-expiry.test.ts`.

The check is in `buildInvoice` in `src/billing/invoice.ts`, just before the existing coupon validation. A coupon is rejected once the current time is at or past `expiresAt`, so a coupon is already rejected at its exact expiry time. Coupons with no expiry, or one in the future, are unaffected.

The check runs before the redemption count goes up, so a rejected coupon doesn't count as a redemption. I left `validateCoupon` alone
